text: In 1880s Bengal, Bulbbul is [married to a wealthy lord when she is barely five|wrong|harm done to children], and grows up trading stories of a chudail with his youngest brother Satya. Twenty years later Satya returns from London to a village where men are dying in what are believed to be the witch's attacks, and Bulbbul now runs the household with a doctor tending her feet. Beneath a blood-red moon, the past surfaces: [a husband's jealous beating|wrong|cruelty at home], and [a woman who comes back to punish cruel men|wants|revenge for a wrong].
